summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) furnishing a management manual and proposal for an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting on November 30, 2026, to be held digitally via Microsoft Teams. The sole agenda item is approval of a new multimodal Long-Term Share-Based Incentive Plan, replacing the prior phantom-share, cash-settled plan approved by the Board. Chairman Raul Calfat signs the message; no price, stake, or transaction terms are stated. This is a routine meeting notice and equity-compensation proposal, not a special situation; watch for shareholder dissent on dilution and plan limits.
